subject: Digital Electronics
questionText:
Two stage SOP circuit can directly be implemented 
 
 
(a) Using NAND gates at first stage & AND gate 
at second stage. 
 
(b) Using NAND gates only at both first & second 
stage. 
 
(c) Using NOR gates only at both first & second 
stage. 
 
(d) None of these.

options.text: Using NAND gates at first stage & AND gate
Using NAND gates only at both first & second
Using NOR gates only at both first & second

explanation: Practice Question from Digital Electronics DPP-07 (Mux, Encoder, Decoder).
